title: 描述与叙述
html:
描述与叙述

概述

本章解决"如何用英语把事情讲清楚"的问题，分为描述事物、叙述事件、细节表达、比较与对比四个部分。内容从静态描写到动态叙述，再到提供细节和进行对比，覆盖表达的基本手法。每个部分配有听说例句与写作表达，兼顾口语讲述与书面描写。建议把描述类词汇与叙述、比较句式结合学习，这样在组织一段完整表达时更从容。

描述事物

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
describe v. 描述 describe in detail, describe the process
illustrate v. 说明 illustrate with examples, clearly illustrate
depict v. 描绘 depict a scenario, accurately depict
outline v. 概述 outline the steps, outline the plan
specify v. 指定/详述 specify requirements, as specified
characterize v. 表征 characterize the behavior, characterize as

听说例句

A: Can you describe the issue in more detail? B: Sure. The page loads normally, but after 5 seconds, the content disappears. Let me illustrate with a screenshot.

A: Could you outline the proposed workflow? B: The user selects a template, customizes the fields, previews the result, and then publishes.

写作表达

  • The following section outlines the key steps involved in the data migration process.
  • The report accurately depicts the current state of the infrastructure and specifies areas for improvement.

叙述事件

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
occur v. 发生 an error occurred, events that occur
proceed v. 继续进行 proceed with, proceed to the next step
sequence n. 顺序 in sequence, event sequence
subsequently adv. 随后 subsequently updated, subsequently discovered
meanwhile adv. 同时 meanwhile, in the meantime
eventually adv. 最终 eventually resolved, eventually completed

听说例句

A: What happened after the deployment? B: The build succeeded, but an error occurred during migration. We rolled back and subsequently identified the issue.

A: Did the fix work? B: Not immediately. Meanwhile, we set up a workaround. Eventually, the root cause was fixed.

写作表达

  • The events occurred in rapid sequence, with the first failure triggering a cascade of downstream issues.
  • The team proceeded with the original plan and subsequently delivered the feature ahead of schedule.

细节表达

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
specifically adv. 具体来说 specifically designed, more specifically
in particular adv. 尤其 in particular, one issue in particular
notably adv. 值得注意的是 most notably, notably absent
approximately adv. 大约 approximately 50%, approximately three weeks
precisely adv. 精确地 precisely defined, more precisely
roughly adv. 大致 roughly estimated, roughly 1000 users

听说例句

A: How many users are affected? B: Approximately 12,000, specifically users on the iOS app. Roughly 80% of them are on the latest version.

A: What's the most notable change in this release? B: Most notably, we redesigned the checkout flow. In particular, the payment step was simplified significantly.

写作表达

  • The feature was specifically designed to address the needs of enterprise customers.
  • Approximately 35% of users engaged with the new feature within the first week, notably exceeding expectations.

比较与对比

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
compare v. 比较 compare with, compared to
contrast v./n. 对比 in contrast, contrast between
superior adj. 优越的 superior performance, far superior
inferior adj. 较差的 inferior quality, slightly inferior
outperform v. 超越 outperform competitors, significantly outperform
distinguish v. 区分 distinguish between, what distinguishes us

听说例句

A: How does the new algorithm compare with the old one? B: It outperforms the previous version by 20% in accuracy. In contrast, the latency is slightly higher.

A: What distinguishes our product from competitors? B: Our superior user experience and real-time data processing. No other tool can match that combination.

写作表达

  • Compared to the previous quarter, user engagement has increased by 18%, while churn rate has decreased.
  • The new system is far superior in terms of scalability, though it is slightly inferior in cold-start performance.
